comparison.objective: Load a filament spool onto rollers and latch a dryer versus tune and lock a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift/place a large spool and swing/press a lid versus tool insertion, bimanual counterhold, fine rotary adjustment, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Spool centered and released on rollers with lid caught and arms returned versus two safe repeatable dynamic carriage stops and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Placement-and-lid closure does not test iterative damping adjustment or setscrew retention.
